items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the associated category fibred in sets inherits (S1) from a category cofibred in groupoids, and inherits (S2) provided the category is a predeformation category, or its fibre over k is a set or a setoid, or the automorphism map over k[epsilon] -> k is surjective (statement lines 3094-3113). The proof (proof lines 3115-3188) repeats the (S1) argument for isomorphism classes and reduces the second half of (S2) to removing a discrepancy between two isomorphisms by one of the three hypotheses. H3: an original diagram chase with a genuine choice argument at the end, written out in full.
